_comment: Source configuration for Integral's adapters. Copy this file to `integral.config.json` (sibling) to override the default. The Vite plugin reads `integral.config.json` at startup; if absent, it falls back to a single 'inference-sim' Nous source pointing at ~/Documents/Projects/inference-sim. Add multiple workspaces (Nous or Coral) by adding entries to the `sources` array. v0.1 supports kinds: 'nous' (Adapter #1, Phases 1-4 + writeback + LLM-driven shaping + run-command surfacing) and 'coral' (Adapter #2, Phases 1-2, read-only). Feature/paper kinds land alongside their adapters in v0.2.
